interpretation.retirement_reason: No public explanation is supplied in these plan outputs: they contain operations, and the selected responses contain zero public reasoning-summary entries. The manager intent or semantic merit of retiring all categories is not established.
interpretation.zero_request_commits: A persisted reevaluation is a Store::reassign commit; it need not be a provider request. Empty-catalog assignment returns Other immediately, so these53 events include45 mechanical named-ID-to-Other moves and8 known Other-to-Other results. They do not establish semantic correction.
interpretation.cap: 16 limits simultaneous active categories, not a minimum, lifetime category IDs, or a requirement to retain categories. Retiring8 to0 and creating10 to10 both fit the cap; new IDs9..18 follow AUTOINCREMENT.
interpretation.cadence: After any applied review, Store resets novelty and last_maintenance. At received53 novelty restarts at0; all8 following new points necessarily enter Other while no catalog exists. At received61 novelty8 triggers review because count>=bootstrap24; the100-point interval has not elapsed. Bootstrap24 is an initial threshold, not a fresh24-point waiting period after retirement.
interpretation.next_work: Creating10 active categories queues all61 persisted points under Contextual global reconsideration, and Engine drains that queue before another new input. K8 means up to two ordered candidate pages for these10 categories; first named choice or explicit refusal stops paging, ordinary Other advances. Events85..145 record this61-point committed drain.
